#@ requires 1 == 1
    #@ ensures 1 == 1
    #@ assigns \nothing
    def _find_calls_in_ir(self, obj: Any, func_names_set: Set[str]) -> Set[str]:
        """Find all function names called within an IR object."""
        calls: Set[str] = set()
        if isinstance(obj, dict):
            if obj.get("type") == "Call" and obj.get("func") in func_names_set:
                calls.add(obj["func"])
            vals_list = list(obj.values())
            n_vals = len(vals_list)
            i = 0
            #@ loop invariant 0 <= i and i <= n_vals
            #@ loop variant n_vals - i
            while i < n_vals:
                v = vals_list[i]
                calls |= self._find_calls_in_ir(v, func_names_set)
                i += 1
        elif isinstance(obj, list):
            n_items = len(obj)
            i = 0
            #@ loop invariant 0 <= i and i <= n_items
            #@ loop variant n_items - i
            while i < n_items:
                item = obj[i]
                calls |= self._find_calls_in_ir(item, func_names_set)
                i += 1
        return calls
